name: bold-photo-editorial
purpose: 강렬한 풀블리드 사진과 하단의 대담한 한국어 헤드라인으로 기관의 활동과 메시지를 한눈에 전달하는 고밀도 인스타그램 에디토리얼 스타일
reference_principles: 사용자가 제공한 인스타그램 피드 캡처에서 관찰한 일반적인 디자인 원리만 반영한다. 제3자 로고, 고유 카피, 사진, 템플릿을 복제하지 않는다.

visual_balance.note: 대략적인 시각적 비중 가이드. 텍스트는 적지만 핵심 메시지는 강하게 전달한다.

composition.image: single full-bleed photograph fills the entire canvas; no card frame or outer margin
composition.overlay: subtle top readability treatment and strong dark gradient over the lower 40-50 percent
composition.brand: first slide: exact institution name centered near the top
composition.eyebrow: small, light-weight introductory phrase above the headline
composition.headline: first slide exactly two explicit bold white lines; later slides may vary
composition.supporting_copy: none on first slide; concise body permitted on later slides
composition.credit: tiny source/slide credit near the bottom edge

typography.headline: bold Korean sans-serif, heavy weight, compact line-height, clear line breaks
typography.eyebrow: light or regular Korean sans-serif, smaller than headline
typography.body: regular Korean sans-serif, one or two short lines
typography.hierarchy: brand > eyebrow > dominant headline > supporting sentence > micro credit

photo_direction: the main activity and children's interaction are legible at a glance
place important faces and activity details in the upper or middle area, keeping the lower third visually calm enough for text
use natural classroom light, believable materials, realistic hands and age-appropriate proportions
vary shot distance and camera angle across carousel slides while preserving the same graphic language
do not bake text, logos, watermarks or captions into generated photos; HTML/CSS renders all typography

color_rules.overlay: rgba(0,0,0,0.72) near the bottom, fading upward
color_rules.accent: use one restrained color from the institution's own brand identity
color_rules.rule: prioritize readable contrast over decorative color

carousel_rules: each slide uses a distinct, relevant photograph
maintain a consistent top brand position and lower headline zone
vary wide, medium and close-up photography
keep titles concise enough for 2-3 lines
supporting copy should add parent-useful context, not repeat the headline
the 3x3 profile grid should feel consistent without repeating the exact same image or crop
avoid: large empty cream margins or framed cards
repeating the same photo or crop
AI-generated gibberish text or fake logos inside images
using real children's images without publication and external-processing permission

signature_cover.scope: first slide of every bold-photo-editorial post
signature_cover.eyebrow: one activity label, e.g. 오늘의 놀이 기록
signature_cover.headline: exactly two explicitly separated bold white lines
signature_cover.supporting_copy: none; move to subsequent slides or caption
signature_cover.credit: 출처 | actual source; detailed attribution in sources.md
signature_cover.crop: full-bleed subject-first zoom-in; face, hands, activity material legible
